## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a preformatted bibliographic reference string for a creative work — a human-readable citation captured verbatim.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for an inline quotation of the work's content (use [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) / [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md)) and avoid it where structured citation/credit metadata is needed — model that through the citation-and-credit constructs.

### How to use

- Carry the citation string on [`gmeow:bibliographicCitation`](gmeow-bibliographicCitation.md) for the flat case; promote to the structured citation relator when authorship, role, and credit must be first-class.

### Examples

- ex:paper [`gmeow:bibliographicCitation`](gmeow-bibliographicCitation.md) "Smith, J. (2024). A Method. J. ACM 71(2).".
